question_en: List feature films animation movies produced in France
question_fr: Répertorier les longs métrages d'animation produits en France
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE.ID_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY.ID_MOVIE WHERE T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE.ID_GENRE = 16 AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY.COUNTRY_CODE = 'FR' AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IS_SHORT_FILM = 0 ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 8
